title: Separating Expert Retention from Autonomous Source Inference in Raw-ECG-Replay-Free Continual ECG Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2607.01674v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In multi-source ECG deployment, new sources may arrive when earlier raw ECGs cannot be retained or replayed. Isolating source-specific classifiers on a frozen backbone prevents parameter interference, but source-unknown inference still requires selecting an appropriate expert. We study this distinction with IRFE-ECG, a controlled continual-deployment framework built on frozen 1024-dimensional ECGFounder features. Each arriving source adds an isolated Balanced-Softmax linear expert, while a lightweight router is re-fitted using retained frozen training features and source labels from previously observed sources. Rather than proposing a new routing architecture, the main contribution is to separate preserved expert performance from autonomous source inference and quantify the resulting deployment gap. Across CPSC, PTB-XL, Georgia, and Chapman-Shaoxing, source-aware expert selection reaches $0.7915 \pm 0.0036$ Macro-F1, close to a match

translated_title: 在无原始心电图回放的持续部署中分离专家性能保持与自主数据源推断
translated_abstract: 在多源心电图（ECG）部署场景中，当早期的原始ECG数据无法保留或回放时，新的数据源可能会陆续到来。在冻结的骨干网络上隔离各数据源专属的分类器可以防止参数干扰，但在数据源未知的情况下进行推断，仍需要选择合适的专家模型。我们通过IRFE-ECG来研究这一区分，该框架是一个建立在冻结的1024维ECGFounder特征之上的受控持续部署框架。每个到来的数据源都会添加一个相互隔离的平衡Softmax（Balanced-Softmax）线性专家，同时利用保留的冻结训练特征以及先前观测到的数据源标签，重新拟合一个轻量级路由器。本文的主要贡献并非提出新的路由架构，而是将“被保留的专家性能”与“自主的数据源推断”区分开来，并量化由此产生的部署差距。在CPSC、PTB-XL、Georgia和Chapman-Shaoxing四个数据集上，源感知的专家选择方法达到了0.7915 ± 0.0036的Macro-F1，接近于（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出IRFE-ECG框架，在无法回放原始心电图的持续部署场景下，通过冻结骨干上的隔离专家与可重新拟合的轻量级路由器，首次将“专家性能保持”与“自主数据源推断”两个问题明确分离，并量化了二者之间的部署性能差距。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces IRFE-ECG, a controlled continual-deployment framework that, without replaying raw ECGs, explicitly separates preserved expert performance from autonomous source inference via isolated experts on a frozen backbone and a re-fitted lightweight router, and quantifies the resulting deployment gap.
